Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

TheAgentCompany: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Consequential Real World Tasks (2412.14161v1) · paper method: Claude 3.5 Sonnet with the common OpenHands CodeAct scaffold achieves 24.0% full task success.

Permanent record ID: cohort6.claim.agentcompany.claude-result

  • This assertion originated as an author proposal; separate review receipts determine its current status.
  • Version-specific reported method or result; no experiment, proof, raw-corpus record or labor audit was independently reproduced.
  • 175 tasks; this is full completion, not the 34.4% partial-credit aggregate. Simulated colleagues and evaluators use a fixed Claude backbone.
